 Kickoff in Kaunas! Lithuania and Liechtenstein get the ball rolling in the final matchday of the UEFA Nations League group stage. Three very intriguing points are up for grabs as both teams look to close out the group on a high note.

 11:43 AM ET an hour ago Lithuania and Liechtenstein look to finish with a victory
 Lithuania enters this match in second place in League D, Group 2, with four points after recording one win, one draw, and one defeat in three matchdays. The team managed by Edgaras Jankauskas will look to make the most of home advantage to secure three points and finish the group stage on a positive note.
 Liechtenstein, meanwhile, sits in third place with one point, following one draw and two defeats. The team managed by Konrad Fünfstück will attempt to improve its performance and end its goal drought after failing to score in its three previous appearances in the competition.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 11:33 AM ET an hour ago Match officials for the game
 Dutch referee Allard Lindhout will be in charge of officiating the match, assisted by Johan Balder and Roy de Nas. Martin van den Kerkhof will serve as the fourth official in this UEFA Nations League fixture.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 11:21 AM ET an hour ago Matchday: Welcome!
 Welcome to VAVEL's LIVE coverage! We are ready to bring you all the action from the match between Lithuania and Liechtenstein, corresponding to Matchday 6 of the 2026/27 UEFA Nations League, League D, Group 2. The Darius and Girėnas Stadium in Kaunas, Lithuania, will host this encounter between two national teams looking to finish their group-stage campaigns with a positive result.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 11:21 AM ET an hour ago Key facts about Lithuania vs Liechtenstein
 Lithuania dominates the head-to-head record between the two national teams with five wins, one draw, and one defeat in seven meetings. The Baltic side has also scored ten goals, compared to Liechtenstein's three.
 In the current edition of the UEFA Nations League, Lithuania has collected four points and scored three goals in its three appearances. Liechtenstein, on the other hand, has managed just one point and is still searching for its first goal in the competition.
 Another important detail is the result of their first meeting, played in September 2026, when Lithuania secured a 2-0 victory at the Rheinpark Stadion. The hosts will look to reproduce that performance and finish the group stage with another win.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 11:20 AM ET an hour ago Key factors in the Lithuania vs Liechtenstein match
 Lithuania will have the responsibility of taking control of the match, making the most of home advantage, and finding spaces against a defense that has struggled during the competition. Maintaining possession and turning their territorial superiority into scoring opportunities will be essential to achieving the desired result.
 Liechtenstein, meanwhile, will need to prioritize defensive organization, limit the available space, and take advantage of any opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. Ending their goal drought will be one of the visitors' main challenges.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 10:51 AM ET 2 hours ago Liechtenstein: looking to end their goal drought and claim their first victory
 Liechtenstein is going through a difficult campaign in the UEFA Nations League. The national team has collected one point from three matches, recording two defeats and one draw, while failing to score in any of its fixtures.
 Their campaign began with a 2-0 defeat against Lithuania, followed by a goalless draw against Azerbaijan before suffering another narrow defeat to the Azerbaijani side in their most recent match. The visitors will need to improve their attacking output and maintain defensive discipline if they are to cause an upset on Baltic soil.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 10:21 AM ET 2 hours ago Head-to-head record between Lithuania and Liechtenstein
 The head-to-head record favors Lithuania, which has won five of the seven meetings between the two national teams, alongside one draw and one defeat. The Baltic side has scored ten goals, while Liechtenstein has found the net three times in these encounters.
 The most recent meeting took place on September 24, 2026, when Lithuania secured a 2-0 victory away from home. The two teams will now meet again in Kaunas, where the hosts will look to repeat that result and extend their historical dominance.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 9:51 AM ET 3 hours ago Darius and Girėnas Stadium, venue for Lithuania vs Liechtenstein
 Darius and Girėnas Stadium, located in the city of Kaunas, is the venue where Lithuania plays its home matches. It has a capacity of 15,315 spectators and is one of the country's main sporting facilities.

 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 9:00 AM ET 4 hours ago Lithuania: looking to finish the group stage on a positive note
 The Lithuanian national team enters this match with a record of one win, one draw, and one defeat in the current edition of the UEFA Nations League. Their campaign began with a 2-0 victory over Liechtenstein, followed by a 1-1 draw against Azerbaijan and a narrow defeat in their second meeting with the Azerbaijani side.
 The Baltic team will have another opportunity to demonstrate its superiority against an opponent it has already defeated in the competition. With four points in the standings, Lithuania will look to impose its style from the opening whistle and take advantage of its opponent's attacking struggles to secure another victory.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 9:00 AM ET 4 hours ago Lithuania and Liechtenstein look to close the group stage with a victory
 Azerbaijan leads the League D Group 2 standings with five points after four matchdays. Lithuania sits in second place with four points, recording one win, one draw, and one defeat in three matches. The hosts will look to collect three points to finish their campaign and maintain their hopes of ending the group stage at the top.
 Liechtenstein, meanwhile, sits in third place with one point after recording one draw and two defeats. The visitors are still searching for their first victory and have yet to score in the competition. The team will aim to improve its record and end its Nations League campaign on a positive note.

My name is Sebastián Ráquira Avellaneda, and I will be bringing you all the information and details ahead of this encounter.
